BiblicalUsage: Daberath is a town on the border of Issachar, given to the Levites as a city of their inheritance. The name appears in the border list and in the list of Levitical towns, and the town stands on the edge of the tribe. It is a boundary town with a priestly household.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Daberath matters because the Levites are given towns among the tribes, and God places His servants in the middle of His people.
